verdict.rationale: Devin exposes a documented REST API (session creation, create_as_user_id, playbooks, knowledge, scheduling) and an MCP server that mirrors many UI actions, suggesting broad but not fully verified parity. However, some UI-specific interactive features (Interactive Browser, live terminal watching, Slack/Teams tagging) aren't clearly exposed via API, and no OpenAPI spec is publicly discoverable (404s), leaving completeness unconfirmed.
